visual_story: 실리콘 웨이퍼가 정밀 가공을 거쳐 다양한 전자 장치의 기반이 되는 삼성전자 테마의 제조 세계.
environment: A vast white-ceramic foundry with nested lithography chambers and a distant device-integration gallery, viewed across an asymmetric diagonal service aisle
hero_object: An upright patterned silicon wafer in a precision lithography cradle, offset right of center, not an HBM tower
lighting: Broad pearl-white ceiling panels with thin cobalt scanner lines and soft warm rim reflections; bright cleanroom depth without blown highlights
energy_flow: Fine scan lines travel from the overhead exposure chamber across wafer traces into the lower-right silicon collection cradle
extraction_target: A faceted silicon tile seated in the lower-right ceramic inspection cradle; no coins, currency or floating reward cubes
foreground_plan: Low service rails at left lead past a textured ceramic inspection surface at right
midground_plan: Wafer and scanner dominate the right-middle; separate process bays remain visible to the left
background_plan: Repeated cleanroom portals retreat diagonally toward a quiet vanishing point above center
desktop_composition: Three-quarter elevated aisle perspective; wafer center at 0.62,0.40 and collection cradle at 0.61,0.67; leave upper-left operational space quiet
mobile_composition: Stack the wafer above its collection cradle in a narrow vertical cleanroom bay; keep the scanner arm entering from the middle-right instead of cropping an entire side process bay
crop_risk: A centered landscape cover would cut the right-side wafer and scanner; a dedicated portrait composition is required

visual_story: HBM 적층 메모리의 정교한 층과 웨이퍼 공정이 하나의 메모리 추출 장치로 모이는 SK하이닉스 테마의 팹.
environment: A deep reflective semiconductor memory fab with a suspended HBM stack, a wafer-scanning station on the left and memory-processing towers on the right
hero_object: A physically detailed tiered HBM package with visible interposer edges suspended above a dormant circular memory collection platform
secondary_objects: robotic fab arms behind the stack
lighting: Cyan fab columns and controlled amber edge reflections on the HBM layers; white task lights reveal microscopic material detail
energy_flow: Local pin lights step down the HBM layer edges toward the platform; reserve every dynamic trail for a later transparent runtime layer
extraction_target: The lower memory collection ring under the suspended package, visibly idle in the raster master
foreground_plan: A wide low extraction platform with engraved physical seams, without glyphs or numerical markings
midground_plan: HBM stack holds the center while wafer and processing tower preserve different left/right silhouettes
background_plan: Blue-lit fab columns and robots diminish through several physically separated depth planes
desktop_composition: Recompose the approved 1539x1022 family direction as a true 16:9 master without stretching or cropping wafer/tower; HBM 0.50,0.37, ring 0.50,0.68
mobile_composition: Keep the complete HBM tier silhouette above a smaller lower ring; bring wafer and tower inward as shallow side stations, rather than cutting them off with center-cover
crop_risk: Existing ratio is about 1.506:1, not 16:9. Existing mobile cover is not accepted product QA; new portrait preserves wafer and tower identity

visual_story: 정밀 실리콘과 장치 조립의 절제된 질감을 보여 주는 애플 테마. 대형 서버나 HBM 공장과 다른 작은 부품의 정교함이 핵심이다.
environment: An architectural precision-device atelier with curved frosted partitions and an immaculate microassembly island, quiet rather than cavernous
hero_object: A sculpted unbranded silicon package held in a levitating precision fixture above a circular sapphire inspection lens
lighting: Large soft ivory area lights, cool silver edge lighting and a restrained rose-copper bounce under the lens; luxury product-photography discipline
energy_flow: Fine optical paths converge through the sapphire lens from individually arranged microassembly tools
extraction_target: A precision-finished silicon module in the sapphire inspection lens, never a currency-shaped reward
foreground_plan: One satin metal bench edge with tactile finish, leaving the lower information area calm
midground_plan: Offset precision silicon fixture and individually legible tool tips with generous negative space
background_plan: Frosted curved partitions reveal two distant assembly rooms without generic server racks
desktop_composition: Low oblique macro-industrial lens with fixture at 0.56,0.43 and inspection lens 0.56,0.66; quiet ivory volume in upper-left
mobile_composition: Compose a vertical optical inspection tower with silicon fixture above lens and two visible grippers from opposite sides; distant partitions rise behind it
crop_risk: Side grippers and curved partition identity would vanish in landscape center crop

visual_story: 분산 컴퓨팅 노드가 안정적인 광섬유 망으로 연결되는 마이크로소프트 테마. 단일 GPU 공장 대신 여러 구역이 협력하는 공간이다.
environment: A monumental enterprise-cloud atrium with terraced distributed compute halls joined by visible optical bridges and an open central light well
hero_object: A layered translucent cloud-fabric routing hub suspended between several physically distinct server halls
lighting: Daylight from the atrium clerestory with azure optical paths and warm white service lights; balanced architectural scale
energy_flow: Several sparse node paths join the routing hub and descend to a small lower optical receiver; keep endpoints distinct
extraction_target: A transparent optical receiver below the routing hub; no token mint or balance display
foreground_plan: A quiet mezzanine rail at left establishes human scale without characters
midground_plan: Glass routing hub sits right-center, with multiple terraces and separate optical bridges
background_plan: Compute halls recede to different heights below a pale atrium ceiling
desktop_composition: Architectural wide interior with hub at 0.60,0.43 and receiver 0.58,0.67; left mezzanine stays low-contrast for factual UI
mobile_composition: Arrange three compute terraces vertically around a tall routing hub; preserve the optical joins inside the middle portrait width
crop_risk: Landscape distributed halls communicate identity through breadth; portrait must restage them as vertical terraces

visual_story: 액체 냉각 GPU와 정렬된 연산 모듈이 광학 인터커넥트로 연결되는 엔비디아 테마의 고성능 연산 시설.
environment: A dense liquid-cooled AI supercompute hall with a diagonal rack canyon and a visible GPU carrier at its near terminus
hero_object: An exposed multi-die GPU module in a heavy copper cold-plate cradle with surrounding coolant plumbing
lighting: Emerald rack accents with cyan coolant reflections and a warm copper key on the GPU carrier; volumetric beams reveal the long rack canyon
energy_flow: Aligned interconnect lanes trace from the rack canyon into the GPU carrier and terminate at a low compute output aperture
extraction_target: A narrow optical output aperture beneath the GPU carrier, distinct from HBM ring and cloud hub
foreground_plan: Copper cold plate and restrained coolant connections create tactile high-performance detail
midground_plan: GPU carrier contrasts with dense but legible rack silhouettes on one diagonal
background_plan: Rack canyon repeats toward a cool distant vanishing point with controlled atmospheric falloff
desktop_composition: Diagonal rack canyon, near GPU at 0.58,0.46 and aperture 0.56,0.66; quiet dark upper-left plane for overlay
mobile_composition: Use a vertical GPU carrier with coolant headers framing both sides and stacked rack depth behind; preserve the entire aperture below
crop_risk: Diagonal rack context and coolant silhouette need portrait-specific positioning

visual_story: 거친 광석부터 정제된 금속까지 질감이 달라지는 골드 테마의 정련소. 화면 속 금은 화폐나 실물 소유권 표시가 아니다.
environment: A vaulted industrial gold refinery with a refractory furnace, a gravity-fed casting channel and substantial stone service architecture
hero_object: A covered refractory crucible above a long precision ingot mold, with a restrained molten-gold surface visible through the furnace aperture
lighting: Warm furnace bounce against deep umber masonry with cool skylight shafts; metallic gold reads through physically plausible reflections rather than global gold tint
energy_flow: A short contained casting channel links the crucible to the mold; actual animated pouring is an optional local server-gated layer
extraction_target: The precision ingot mold at the near end of the casting channel; unmarked industrial metal without coins or payment symbolism
foreground_plan: Heavy refractory mold and ore textures establish tactile weight
midground_plan: Crucible aperture and casting channel remain visually separate, on a rightward diagonal
background_plan: Arched refinery roof and furnace stacks recede through warm haze
desktop_composition: Wide refinery aisle with crucible at 0.60,0.43 and mold at 0.55,0.68; lower-left service wall leaves calm overlay room
mobile_composition: Place crucible above the mold in a tall furnace bay; a short visible channel connects them with ore tray tucked mid-left
crop_risk: Wide casting channel and ore stage cannot be lost to a center crop

visual_story: 차가운 은 결정이 전해 정제와 정밀 가공을 거쳐 정제 금속으로 이어지는 실버 테마. 골드 장면의 색만 바꾸지 않는다.
environment: A cool silver electrorefining laboratory with a long segmented electrolytic bath and a crystal inspection station under sawtooth roof daylight
hero_object: A dendritic silver crystal lifted over a rectangular purification bath by a precision gantry
lighting: Cold daylight broken across silver facets, violet inspection light and narrow white highlights on brushed metal; no gold furnace glow
energy_flow: Fine local charge traces pass through bath plates into the crystal inspection station, ending at a cooled bar cradle
extraction_target: A brushed silver bar cradle below the inspection station, unmarked and industrial rather than monetary
foreground_plan: Bath rim and textured plate edges catch narrow silver highlights
midground_plan: Gantry-held dendritic crystal contrasts with rectangular purification cells
background_plan: Sawtooth windows and repeating laboratory bays provide cool receding depth
desktop_composition: Side-oblique view along the bath; crystal at 0.58,0.42 and bar cradle 0.55,0.67; reserve quiet top-left daylight wall
mobile_composition: Use a vertically suspended crystal above stacked short purification cells and lower bar cradle; gantry remains readable across the middle width
crop_risk: Horizontal bath and plate geometry need restaging, not hue-swapping the gold refinery

visual_story: 해시 경로가 무거운 블록 봉인 장치로 모이는 비트코인 테마. 실제 외부 네트워크 채굴이나 토큰 지급을 주장하지 않는 가상 세계.
environment: A basalt block-forging hall with substantial parallel hash-channel grooves and a mechanical seal press under a cavernous ribbed roof
hero_object: A dark interlocking block assembly seated under a heavy seal press; architectural block, not a coin or logo
lighting: Low amber channel light with broad cool roof shafts and a precise bronze rim on the seal press; strong heavy shadows
energy_flow: Parallel hash lanes converge at the block press and end at the visible sealed-block receiving tray
extraction_target: The physical block receiving tray beneath the press; no token logo, payment stamp or financial implication
foreground_plan: Large worn rail surfaces lead toward a heavy near block tray
midground_plan: Seal press and interlocking block distinguish the silhouette from generic crypto crystals
background_plan: Parallel cabinets and roof ribs retreat through a deep basalt nave
desktop_composition: Low fixed aisle perspective; block press at 0.56,0.44 and receiving tray 0.56,0.68; sparse upper-left stone wall
mobile_composition: Frame the entire tall press above its tray; hash rails enter diagonally within the middle portrait area and roof ribs provide vertical depth
crop_risk: Parallel hash lanes at the landscape edges establish identity and need a new portrait entry direction

visual_story: 여러 검증 노드가 투명한 연결 구조로 협력하는 이더리움 테마. 비트코인의 봉인 공장과 다른 분산 네트워크 공간.
environment: A tall vaulted validator conservatory with separate polygonal node pedestals connected by suspended optical lattice bridges
hero_object: A faceted transparent consensus prism surrounded by distinct validator pedestals, not a branded diamond logo
lighting: Soft violet node interiors, ice-blue lattice reflections and diffuse high clerestory light; balanced luminous transparency
energy_flow: Sparse short paths from separate pedestals meet around the prism and terminate in a clear lower consensus receiver
extraction_target: A clear consensus receiver directly below the prism; abstract presentation without network finality or financial guarantee
foreground_plan: A glass walkway edge exposes the nearest node pedestal below
midground_plan: Prism and several independently legible node pedestals form a spatial graph
background_plan: Tall lattice arches and distant validators fall into cool atmospheric depth
desktop_composition: Open asymmetric validator arc with prism at 0.59,0.42 and receiver 0.58,0.66; nodes distributed at different depths, upper-left quiet
mobile_composition: Build a vertical validator spiral around the prism with three complete nodes visible in the middle; keep receiver below and arches above
crop_risk: A wide node graph needs a portrait spiral; cutting to the prism alone removes distributed identity

visual_story: 여러 경로가 규칙적으로 교차하는 BNB 테마의 네트워크 허브. 거래소 제휴·실제 전송·코인 지급을 암시하지 않는다.
environment: A stepped ceramic network-routing transit hall with intersecting hexagonal conduit galleries and a central switchyard beneath a geometric skylight
hero_object: An unbranded hexagonal routing switchboard built from mechanically interlocking ceramic modules, deliberately unlike Ethereum's transparent prism
lighting: Honey-yellow conduit edges against graphite with clean white skylight illumination and cool nickel reflections; restrained color, no exchange branding
energy_flow: Several orthogonal and diagonal lanes converge through distinct gate modules and terminate at a lower routing collector
extraction_target: A ceramic routing collector at the lower switchyard edge; not a token dispenser or currency tray
foreground_plan: Two conduit bridges frame the near collector without covering the lower safe area
midground_plan: Stepped switchboard geometry exposes multiple discrete path junctions
background_plan: Hexagonal galleries and skylight beams reveal successive network tiers
desktop_composition: Fixed elevated switchyard perspective; hub 0.60,0.45, collector 0.58,0.68; geometry flows from upper-right to lower-middle, left wall stays calm
mobile_composition: Restage the switchyard as three vertical routing tiers; compact hexagonal hub and lower collector stay fully inside the central portrait corridor
crop_risk: Lateral conduit bridges cannot be center-cropped without losing the routing story

visual_story: 두 구역을 연결하는 정밀 릴레이 다리와 경로 확인 장치가 보이는 XRP 테마. 실제 결제·은행 제휴를 의미하지 않는다.
environment: A long cool-metal relay terminal with two distinct infrastructure halls joined by a suspended optical transfer bridge across an open central void
hero_object: A precision relay bridge with a visible optical handshake coupler at its center, not a crystal, coin or exchange mark
lighting: Silver-white bridge illumination, deep-blue void reflections and a quiet cyan line at the coupler; no gold token atmosphere
energy_flow: A single clearly traceable relay path crosses between halls through the coupler and descends into the lower verification dock
extraction_target: The small verification dock below the bridge coupler; no banking symbols, payment claims or external-network success assertion
foreground_plan: Near terminal platform edge and suspended bridge ribs establish a deep void
midground_plan: Long bridge and coupler remain the distinctive horizontal hero silhouette
background_plan: Far terminal chamber glows through narrow steel portals across the void
desktop_composition: Oblique long-bridge view; coupler 0.61,0.43 and dock 0.59,0.66; leave upper-left structural wall low detail
mobile_composition: Turn the bridge into a diagonal rising relay span connecting two vertically separated halls; keep coupler and verification dock centered without cropping bridge endpoints
crop_risk: Horizontal two-terminal bridge needs a separately staged diagonal portrait master
